speaker: charlie
text: Well that is the Bright Side wrapped up for today, whales, trees, coral and cracking sport, not a bad way to spend twenty minutes. Thanks for hanging out with us.

speaker: alice
text: It really was a good one today, I am still thinking about those whale numbers to be honest. Thanks to Sam for sorting our weather plans too, sounds like a beauty of a week ahead.

speaker: charlie
text: Absolutely, get outside, soak up that spring sunshine and maybe keep an eye out for a fin or two if you are near the coast.

speaker: alice
text: We will be back tomorrow with more good news from right across Queensland and beyond. Until then, look after yourselves and each other.

speaker: charlie
text: See ya then, this has been ParkSyde Bright Side, take care out there.
